From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps on private deployment — feasibility & timing

Hi Amelia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep the momentum:  

Summary from today's discovery
- Primary use case: customer-facing recommender and analytics chatbot (low-latency, P95 < 150ms)
- Estimated steady-state qps: ~40 requests/minute, spiky bursts to 300/min during reports
- Key requirements: VPC private deployment (data residency + network egress controls), SOC2 evidence, and KMS integration

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a short one-pager that outlines Dedicated vs. Private (VPC/on-prem) tradeoffs — this should help your infra team. (redwood-private-deploy-one-pager.pdf)
2) Please ask your network/security lead to review the attached network checklist (finlytics-network-checklist.xlsx). If you can get Carlos on a quick sync we can validate port/IP requirements.
3) If this looks aligned, we can schedule a 30-minute architecture workshop with our presales engineer and your infra team to scope a pilot and an indicative cost estimate. 

Questions for you before we sync:
- Is there an internal procurement window or target decision date (you mentioned Q1 in passing)?
- Any dedicated compliance evidence beyond SOC2 we should prepare?

Available slots for the workshop next week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 2–4 PT. If none of those work, I can send a Calendly link.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on what makes sense for your timeline.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); finlytics-network-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Amelia Johnson <amelia@finlytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps on private deployment — feasibility & timing

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and materials. I shared both docs with our infra and security folks; Carlos Vega (cc'd here) is our network lead and will take a look at the checklist. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- High-level timeline: we're tentatively aiming to have a vendor decision by end of Q1 2027, but that could slip earlier/later depending on procurement bandwidth.
- Budget: we don't have a final number yet — can you provide an indicative cost range for a Dedicated (exclusive GPU pool) vs. Private (VPC-hosted, managed control plane) pilot for our expected load? A rough monthly figure and any up-front onboarding or license fees would be helpful.
- Compliance: SOC2 is primary. We may need ISO27001 evidence later but not urgent for the pilot.

Carlos — if you can confirm availability for a 30-minute workshop next week, that would be great. Otherwise send preferred windows and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Amelia Johnson
VP Product, Finlytics
amelia@finlytics.com

[Automated note: I may be OOO Nov 9-11 — Carlos can drive network review in that window.]

Hi Amelia / Carlos — bumping this in case it got lost while you were triaging. Quick answers to the two asks: 

- Indicative pricing: for your load we typically see pilot-months in the range of $8k–$14k/mo for Dedicated vs $6k–$10k/mo for VPC-managed Private, depending on burst capacity and required redundancy. There may be one-time onboarding fees (usually a few thousand) for network validation and dedicated monitoring. Rishi (cc) can follow up with a more detailed worksheet if helpful.
- Workshop: happy to run a 30-minute architecture scoping session — still have Tue/Wed 10–12 PT next week.

If it helps, I can also send a short, filled-in financial worksheet with three scenarios (pilot, production-min, production-peak) to make procurement conversations easier. Would you like that?

Cheers,
Vanessa

Option B (recommended): 30-minute architecture workshop with our presales engineer and your infra lead to validate the checklist and lock down pilot scope. We can share recording and a memo after the session.
